title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
taper: From the Collection of Jeff Knudsen

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a historically pivotal Dead show that delivers the first documented performances of Truckin', Ripple, Brokedown Palace and Operator.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this audience tape as a landmark document, highlighting its crystal‑clear transfer and the historic debut of several classic songs. The performance is described as epic and deeply moving, while the sound quality—despite being crowd‑sourced—is praised as surprisingly clean and well‑balanced.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are enthusiastic (average 4.75★) and stress both the show's historic importance and the surprisingly excellent audio quality, yielding a top‑tier combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No soundboard present; audience capture is described as 'killer' and 'so clearly for the first time', indicating a very clean transfer with good balance despite crowd ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers focus on the historic significance rather than set pacing, noting that the early versions of these songs provide a unique glimpse into their evolution.
